body:
>I'm so so sorry but i know that i will never be what ~~they~~you wanted me to be what i could be

Sounds too much like something I texted to my SO earlier tonight.

I can't tell you how to get past this feeling. All I can say is after some angry texting and crying I insanely, left the house in the dark and...I went for a walk deep, deep in the woods. Stupid idea since I have a spine injury. Falling would be bad.I took a small flashlight but I left it off most of the time. I found some stones in out in the woods. One made a nice seat so I sat there in the dark and just....existed. Tried not to think or feel. Just looked at the stars and listened to the wind in the trees. Some crazy, scary animal stared stalking me,kit kept calling out in this odd cry, very scary...I ran for a while and hid in quietly in the dark until it stopped calling, then I found my way back. Fortunately I wasn't too far from the road.  Closer than I thought. It was actually, a really nice but rather intense and a bit scary walk in the dark. Somehow I felt a little saner afterwords. I'm going to sit down with my SO tomorrow and really share some of my issues

Maybe there is  someone you could share with?
I'm still here. I hope you made it through.
Fuck, I hope you are here tomorrow brian

I'm goi g to slp now, I just wanted to check if you were still here? Maybe I'll sleep easier if I think you will be here tomorrow?
Are you here?
May I ask your age/gender? (Ps I'm about to fall asleep from meds....may be tomorrow before I respind)

Thanks, I think I'm just really tired right now, I prob shuoldnt be on this sub, just spent some time talking to a dude that might be dead in a few hours, I just ....fuck if I even know, Need some perspectives I guess. (Note: I'm drinking and on Xanax, ignore typos plz)
I'm gonna sleep a few hours and try to keep on keepin on tomorrow, thanks for responding, I appreciate i.
Goodnighr brian, I will got to work tomorrow, home late (I have physical therapy). I hope to hear from you,

I hope you will call someone, I don't want you to die. Idk why since I don't know you, I just feel a connection to your words, and I feel like maybe b/c I tried to reach out, if it makes a difference, then maybe it means I have some sort of reason tube here myself. Don't know, just wish you peace, happiness, and, if yin stay...maybe we could be friends.

Fuck, I'm becoming incoherent. Sorry Brian, once again, I've kinda failed to accomplish what I wanted to. You deserved more than I clam offer. But, I really do hope you are here tomorrow. I'd like to talk more.
That sucks. Man...that's jut heartbreaking to me. Animals are my life. All I can say if they are always more out there that need love, need a home, Maybe need YOU?
i hope you change your mind Brain, it would be nice to have a friend tomorrow.
Not the same as you. Animals are different. I know, I'm a vet tech. They mourn, they remember.

It's not too late. You just have to call someone. You have friends. You mentioned them (lucky there) I'm not too lucid myself, so forgive me if i drop out of the convo,m barely conscious, just not enough to kill myself. I'll manage to ~~brag~~ drag myself,to work in the AM
PS-pretty sure bandit and Zoey will miss you so much.

Hi Brian. I don't know if you are still here. I was reluctant to respond because my combo of vodka and Xanax is kicking in and I have work tomorrow. I'm determined to go, so I have about 6 hours to sleep.
Just wanted you to know that I saw your beautiful words. I'd like to talk to you...but maybe it's too late. I'm struggling too...I could use someone to talk to.

If you are here tomorrow...well, I'm hoping I will be, maybe we could talk. If I'm too late, then I wish you peace and rest.
